ISSUE_KIND: drainage
ISSUE: Sinkhole and road collapse involving a storm drain
DETAILS: The photo shows a major street cave-in and sinkhole spanning across a residential concrete road, exposing a large underground void where a storm drainage structure appears to have failed, with a traffic sign post dangling inside. There is no user note.
ORGANIZATION: Prince George's County Government
DEPARTMENT: Department of Public Works and Transportation (DPW&T), Office of Highway Maintenance / Office of Storm Drain Maintenance
WHY: Tecumseh Street in Adelphi is an unincorporated residential street located within Prince George's County, making its roadway and underlying public storm drain system the maintenance responsibility of the county's Department of Public Works and Transportation.
COVERAGE_URL: https://www.princegeorgescountymd.gov/departments-offices/public-works-transportation/highway-maintenance/sinkhole-storm-drain-channel-and-ditch-maintenance
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "If the drainage problem is on the county road or county right-of-way (for example, clogged storm drain, ponding water in the road, etc.), please click HERE to enter a service request by selecting “Storm Drain, Channel, Ditch Maintenance.”"
